semantic_input.title: Ken Follett's The Pillars of the Earth
semantic_input.short_description: 12th century, England: In a time of poverty and war, a small town begins the construction of a cathedral to claim wealth and safety for its people. In their struggle to survive, lives and destinies intertwine. Based on Ken Follett's world-bestseller ‘The Pillars of the Earth’.

semantic_input.title: Warhammer: End Times - Vermintide
semantic_input.short_description: Vermintide is an epic co-operative action combat adventure set in the End Times of the iconic Warhammer Fantasy world.

semantic_input.title: PAYDAY™ The Heist
semantic_input.short_description: Take on the role of a hardened career criminal executing intense, dynamic heists in constant pursuit of the next “big score”

semantic_input.title: Streamer Life Simulator
semantic_input.short_description: Streamer Life Simulator is a very comprehensive streamer life simulation game. Be the most popular streamer in the world.

semantic_input.title: BURIED STARS
semantic_input.short_description:
A mystery adventure set at the collapse site of a live survival audition show.
Trapped contestants communicate with each other—and the outside world through social media—as they wait for rescue. But as unexpected events unfold, trust begins to crack, and survival becomes far more complicated.

semantic_input.title: Hardspace: Shipbreaker
semantic_input.short_description: Equipped with cutting-edge salvaging tech, carve & slice spaceships to recover valuable materials. Upgrade your gear to take on more lucrative contracts and pay your billion credits debt to LYNX Corp!

semantic_input.title: Another Crab's Treasure
semantic_input.short_description: In a vibrant undersea kingdom on the verge of collapse, a hermit crab embarks on a treasure hunt to buy back his repossessed shell. The second game from AGGRO CRAB.

semantic_input.title: Internet Cafe Simulator 2
semantic_input.short_description: Internet Cafe Simulator 2 is an extremely comprehensive and detailed internet cafe business simulation game.

semantic_input.title: HunterX
semantic_input.short_description:
HunterX is an action-adventure game full of spirited battles. 
Use various styles of weapons and magic to experience your own fighting style and explore a great world.

semantic_input.title: Lamentum
semantic_input.short_description: Lamentum is a pixel art survival horror game, set in New England in the mid-nineteenth century.

semantic_input.title: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters
semantic_input.short_description: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters is a Korean survival horror-adventure. Venture from your deserted school to survive the horrors of the night. Explore the surrounding Sehwa district and uncover the shadow realm's dark secrets. Use everything at your disposal to avoid a demoness hellbent on killing you!

semantic_input.title: A Monster's Expedition
semantic_input.short_description: An adorable and relaxing open world puzzle adventure for monsters who love to learn about humans!

semantic_input.title: Jump King
semantic_input.short_description: Take up the challenge and face true high-stakes platforming in Jump King! Struggle upwards in search of the Smoking Hot Babe of legend, but explore with care; a single missed jump could lead to a long fall back down...

semantic_input.title: Bendy and the Dark Revival
semantic_input.short_description: Bendy and the Dark Revival® is a first-person survival horror game set in the creepiest cartoon studio to ever exist. Discover the truth. Escape the studio. Above all, fear the Ink Demon…and survive.

semantic_input.title: Automobilista 2
semantic_input.short_description: Automobilista 2 is all the racing simulators you ever wanted - in just one.  An incredibly diverse collection of cars and tracks cohesively simulated, featuring incredible graphics and audio quality, dynamic weather and track conditions and the best VR support for a racing experience like no other.

semantic_input.title: Before Your Eyes
semantic_input.short_description: Embark on an emotional first-person narrative adventure where you control the story—and affect its outcomes—with your real-life blinks. With this innovative technique you will fully immerse yourself in a world of memories, both joyous and heartbreaking, as your whole life flashes before your eyes.

semantic_input.title: Biped
semantic_input.short_description: Biped is a coop action adventure game with a strong focus on moment-to-moment collaboration between 2 players.

semantic_input.title: Mutazione
semantic_input.short_description: A mutant soap opera where small-town gossip meets the supernatural. Explore the Mutazione community as Kai as she cares for her ailing grandfather. Discover magical gardens, new friends & old secrets. They can survive an apocalyptic meteor strike, but can they survive their small-town drama?

semantic_input.title: My Time at Sandrock
semantic_input.short_description: Travel to the desert community of Sandrock and take on the role of a fledgling Builder. Use your trusty toolset to gather resources, construct machines, and turn your run-down workshop into a well-oiled production facility to save the town from the jaws of economic ruin!

semantic_input.title: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4
semantic_input.short_description: Step into the world of One Piece like never before in Pirate Warriors 4! Unleash devastating attacks against massive enemy armies and relive iconic anime arcs in an action-packed adventure. With stunning visuals, fast-paced combat, and fan-favorite characters, experience a One Piece power fantasy.

semantic_input.title: Jack Move
semantic_input.short_description: Jack Move is a JRPG that features a unique blend of gritty cyberpunk story telling, turn based battles and beautiful modern pixel art. Take on the role of Noa, a vigilante hacker who is thrust into a world of murder, kidnapping and dark research after her father goes missing.

semantic_input.title: FlatOut: Ultimate Carnage Collector's Edition
semantic_input.short_description: Ready for the aggressive, adrenaline-filled ride that leaves you breathless? FlatOut: Ultimate Carnage Collector's Edition is all about destructive action. With carnage modes like the Deathmatch derby, Carnage Race and Head-on races are pure wreck-filled, adrenaline-pumping rides of maximum mayhem.

semantic_input.title: Eternights
semantic_input.short_description: Eternights is a dating action game where you try to make the most out of life during the apocalypse. Monday: Go on a date. Tuesday: Clear dungeon. Friday: Freak out! The clock is ticking!!

semantic_input.title: RoboCop: Rogue City
semantic_input.short_description: Become the legendary part man, part machine, all cop hero and deliver justice in Old Detroit.

semantic_input.title: DREDGE
semantic_input.short_description: DREDGE is a single-player fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and dredge the depths for long-buried secrets. Explore a mysterious archipelago and discover why some things are best left forgotten.

semantic_input.title: FlatOut 2
semantic_input.short_description: Experience the drive of your life as you throw yourself around on and off the track causing fences to shatter, tyre walls explode, water tanks and barrels fly across the track into other cars.
